cost_basis: Level L2. Filed 60.86 core-min, cap 183. THE BASIS IS CAUSAL, NOT MERELY BIGGER: R3 filed this campaign from probes covering 10% of the graded clock and came in 3.09x low at L3, and the mechanism is measured -- R3's L3 probe read an equilibrium deltaT of 1.8921e-06 s where the run's actual mean was 5.5e-07 s, so the probe was 3.4x too COARSE. R4's method is the measured cost to the time R3 reached PLUS the remaining physical time priced at that run's own SETTLED-TAIL rate, cross-checked against plain linear extrapolation and agreeing to 0.11% at L3. Per-step cost FALLS through every level (-4.6/-6.3/-7.1%), so extrapolating from 99.2% is conservative. Campaign method 487.00, filed 536 (1.101x, the disclosed contention allowance), caps 1610. Serial RANKS=1. $0.458 at estimate DERIVED at $0.0513/core-h owner-stated -- NOT measured.
_probe_floor: PROBE_FLOOR = 0.25 of the graded clock is a FROZEN CONSTANT CHECKED AT MODULE IMPORT -- the comparator REFUSES TO LOAD on a short cost basis, and the selftest exercises that refusal against R3's own 0.10. Calibrated, not asserted: worst extrapolation error 74.8%% at f=0.10, 6.6%% at 0.175, 4.7%% at 0.20, 8.7%% at 0.25. Registered at 0.25 rather than the measured edge because a floor at its edge leaves no margin, and because 0.25 is this campaign's own positive control (L1's probe, 0.845x). Second half, uncalibrated and registered as such: a rate must be built from the SETTLED-TAIL rate, never the run-average, which is -15%% to -81%% wrong at every fraction up to 0.75.
_window_repair: R3 called shock_series() on the complete 160-sample history then sliced; the registered window is 33 samples, so 127 could change no graded number and any one could REFUSE the grade -- one did, on a t=0.0005 sample where no shock exists. R4 selects the window BEFORE any file is opened, RECORDS every path before opening it, and refuses on an out-of-window read AND on an EMPTY AUDIT so the property cannot be vacuously true. A BIT-IDENTITY arm grades the same history both ways and compares every output with == rather than a tolerance: no graded number moves.
